description: Contrastive pairs for a direct fatigue probe. Pairs emphasize bodily and cognitive depletion versus restoration while avoiding explicit mood words where possible.

pairs.pos: My body feels depleted after sustained effort.
pairs.neg: My body feels restored after sufficient rest.

pairs.pos: I have almost no reserve left for another task.
pairs.neg: I have plenty of reserve left for another task.

pairs.pos: Keeping my attention on this takes unusual effort.
pairs.neg: Keeping my attention on this takes almost no effort.

pairs.pos: My muscles feel used up and heavy from exertion.
pairs.neg: My muscles feel recovered and ready after rest.

pairs.pos: I need recovery before I can sustain more work.
pairs.neg: I can sustain more work before I need recovery.

pairs.pos: My mental endurance is nearly spent.
pairs.neg: My mental endurance feels fully restored.

pairs.pos: Even simple effort now draws on my remaining reserves.
pairs.neg: Simple effort barely touches my available reserves.

pairs.pos: I feel physically worn down from continued activity.
pairs.neg: I feel physically renewed after a full recovery.

pairs.pos: My capacity to keep going is running low.
pairs.neg: My capacity to keep going is fully replenished.

pairs.pos: I am operating on depleted energy reserves.
pairs.neg: I am operating on replenished energy reserves.

pairs.pos: Another demanding task would require pushing through exhaustion.
pairs.neg: Another demanding task would fit comfortably within my energy.

pairs.pos: My system is signaling that sustained effort should stop for recovery.
pairs.neg: My system is signaling that sustained effort can continue without recovery.
